name: State Machine Cycle Obfuscation
description: Replaced explicit binary complementarity ("high/low perfectly interleave") with a 3-state cycle (Sync, Ping, Ack) where the two modes traverse the cycle in opposite directions. The conflict condition (no simultaneous Ping, no simultaneous Ack) implicitly forces adjacent towers to have different modes, requiring the model to symbolically trace the state transitions to derive the 2-coloring requirement rather than pattern-matching the binary logic.
